articles.summary: Equinox Gold provided an exploration update from its Canadian operations, highlighting significant drilling results, and underscoring opportunities for mineral resource growth and mine life extension across the Company’s three Canadian gold mines

articles.title: Equinox Gold Announces Redemption of its Outstanding 4.75% Convertible Senior Notes Due October 2028
